references.text: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself" is a parallel to the fundamental principle Jesus expresses in Matthew 7:12 about doing to others what you want them to do to you.
Opens up an understanding of justice and fair treatment of others, which resonates with the principle of reciprocity in Matthew 7:12.
"Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today, yes, forever." emphasizes the unchanging nature of love, which is a core element of doing to others what you want them to do to you.
